groups.title: HKMA SPM TM-G-1 Technology Risk Management + TM-C-1 Cyber Risk (Hong Kong)

controls.title: TM-G-1 7.1 — whether the AI outsources technology services must be declared true or false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: TM-G-1 7.1 — whether the AI outsources technology services must be declared true or false

controls.title: TM-G-1 2.6 — whether the AI relies on overseas offices for IT controls or support must be declared true or false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: TM-G-1 2.6 — whether the AI relies on overseas offices for IT controls or support must be declared true or false

controls.title: TM-G-1 6.3 — whether the AI deploys wireless LANs must be declared true or false

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: TM-G-1 6.3 — whether the AI deploys wireless LANs must be declared true or false

controls.title: IT control policies setting the ground rules for IT controls are developed by senior management, formally approved by the Board or its committee, and implemented across IT functions and business units

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IT control policies setting the ground rules for IT controls are developed by senior management, formally approved by the Board or its committee, and implemented across IT functions and business units

controls.title: IT control policies cover at least security management, system development and change management, information processing, communications networks and service providers, and are reviewed regularly and

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IT control policies cover at least security management, system development and change management, information processing, communications networks and service providers, and are reviewed regularly and updated

controls.title: Processes to verify compliance with IT control policies and to seek approval for dispensation are specified, with defined consequences for non-adherence

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Processes to verify compliance with IT control policies and to seek approval for dispensation are specified, with defined consequences for non-adherence

controls.title: Mechanisms (periodic reminders, orientation for new recruits) promote regular awareness of IT control policies

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Mechanisms (periodic reminders, orientation for new recruits) promote regular awareness of IT control policies

controls.title: An IT organisation structure and job descriptions for IT functions are documented and approved by senior management

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An IT organisation structure and job descriptions for IT functions are documented and approved by senior management

controls.title: Segregation of duties within and among IT functions is enforced (developers have no production access; security management has no conflicting duties), with compensating controls such as peer review wh

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Segregation of duties within and among IT functions is enforced (developers have no production access; security management has no conflicting duties), with compensating controls such as peer review where segregation is impractical

controls.title: An IT planning or steering committee of senior management, business units and IT meets regularly and reports major technology initiatives and material IT issues to senior management and the Board

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An IT planning or steering committee of senior management, business units and IT meets regularly and reports major technology initiatives and material IT issues to senior management and the Board

controls.title: A documented IT strategy covering long- and short-term initiatives is endorsed by the Board and senior management and reviewed at least annually

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A documented IT strategy covering long- and short-term initiatives is endorsed by the Board and senior management and reviewed at least annually

controls.title: The function responsible for the technology risk management (TRM) process is clearly established

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The function responsible for the technology risk management (TRM) process is clearly established

controls.title: The TRM function assists business units and IT in identifying, measuring, monitoring and controlling technology risks, promotes policy compliance and supports investigation of technology-related fraud

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The TRM function assists business units and IT in identifying, measuring, monitoring and controlling technology risks, promotes policy compliance and supports investigation of technology-related frauds and incidents

controls.title: A formal technology risk acknowledgement and acceptance process reviews, evaluates and approves major non-compliance with IT control policies: risk description and assessment, mitigating controls, rem

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A formal technology risk acknowledgement and acceptance process reviews, evaluates and approves major non-compliance with IT control policies: risk description and assessment, mitigating controls, remedial plan, approval by the risk owner and senior management

controls.title: Technology audits periodically assess the TRM process and IT controls under an annual technology audit plan; audit issues are recorded, followed up and rectified

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Technology audits periodically assess the TRM process and IT controls under an annual technology audit plan; audit issues are recorded, followed up and rectified

controls.title: Where in-house technology audit expertise is insufficient it is supplemented by external specialists or group technology auditors

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where in-house technology audit expertise is insufficient it is supplemented by external specialists or group technology auditors

controls.title: Staff of IT functions, the TRM function and technology audit are competent, with sufficient staffing for present and expected demand and turnover

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Staff of IT functions, the TRM function and technology audit are competent, with sufficient staffing for present and expected demand and turnover

controls.title: A process identifies material skill gaps against a skill matrix and an adequate training programme is in place; professional qualifications are encouraged for security, TRM and audit staff

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A process identifies material skill gaps against a skill matrix and an adequate training programme is in place; professional qualifications are encouraged for security, TRM and audit staff

controls.title: Respective responsibilities of local and overseas offices for IT controls and support are clearly set out in policies, procedures or service agreements

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Respective responsibilities of local and overseas offices for IT controls and support are clearly set out in policies, procedures or service agreements

controls.title: Each application system has an assigned information owner accountable for confidentiality and integrity, working with the TRM and IT functions

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Each application system has an assigned information owner accountable for confidentiality and integrity, working with the TRM and IT functions

controls.title: Information is classified by sensitivity with guidelines, definitions and protection procedures for each class

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Information is classified by sensitivity with guidelines, definitions and protection procedures for each class

controls.title: Confidentiality is protected regardless of media; secure disposal and destruction processes exist for sensitive paper and electronic media

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Confidentiality is protected regardless of media; secure disposal and destruction processes exist for sensitive paper and electronic media

controls.title: Cryptography uses industry-accepted solutions with sound key management: secure generation, distribution, storage, entry, use and archiving (tamper-resistant storage recommended) and off-site backup o

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cryptography uses industry-accepted solutions with sound key management: secure generation, distribution, storage, entry, use and archiving (tamper-resistant storage recommended) and off-site backup of keys under equivalent controls

controls.title: Access to information and application systems is restricted by authentication and access control rules; every user has a unique ID with an appropriate authentication method

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Access to information and application systems is restricted by authentication and access control rules; every user has a unique ID with an appropriate authentication method

controls.title: Effective password rules avoid easy-to-guess passwords and enforce periodic change; multi-factor authentication is used for higher-risk transactions and activities (payments, financial messages, mobil

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Effective password rules avoid easy-to-guess passwords and enforce periodic change; multi-factor authentication is used for higher-risk transactions and activities (payments, financial messages, mobile computing)

controls.title: Privileged and emergency IDs are granted only necessary authorities, formally approved before release, monitored (peer review of logs), safeguarded, and have passwords changed immediately on return

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Privileged and emergency IDs are granted only necessary authorities, formally approved before release, monitored (peer review of logs), safeguarded, and have passwords changed immediately on return

controls.title: A security administration function grants, changes and removes access with information-owner approval, removes rights on leaving or role change, re-certifies user access periodically (e.g. annually),

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A security administration function grants, changes and removes access with information-owner approval, removes rights on leaving or role change, re-certifies user access periodically (e.g. annually), reviews security logs and violation reports timely, and performs incident analysis, reporting and investigation

controls.title: Segregation of duties or compensating controls within the security administration function mitigate unauthorised activity by that function

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Segregation of duties or compensating controls within the security administration function mitigate unauthorised activity by that function

controls.title: Incident response and reporting procedures handle security incidents during and outside office hours and include timely reporting to the HKMA of confirmed IT-related fraud or major security breaches

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Incident response and reporting procedures handle security incidents during and outside office hours and include timely reporting to the HKMA of confirmed IT-related fraud or major security breaches

controls.title: Baseline security requirements safeguard applications, operating systems, system software and databases: authenticated and authorised access, periodic static-data integrity checks, secure configuratio

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Baseline security requirements safeguard applications, operating systems, system software and databases: authenticated and authorised access, periodic static-data integrity checks, secure configuration with unnecessary services removed, timely vendor patching with clear responsibility, documented configurations with periodic certification, and protected logging and monitoring of system and user activity

controls.title: End-user computing is controlled: data security, documentation, storage and backup, recovery, audit responsibilities and training

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: End-user computing is controlled: data security, documentation, storage and backup, recovery, audit responsibilities and training

controls.title: Mobile computing controls cover user approval, remote-access authentication, protection of devices against theft and malware, encryption of sensitive data in the mobile environment and in transit, and

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Mobile computing controls cover user approval, remote-access authentication, protection of devices against theft and malware, encryption of sensitive data in the mobile environment and in transit, and backup of mobile data

controls.title: Malicious-software controls prohibit unauthorised downloads and doubtful sites, keep reputable anti-virus current, block executables and mobile code with known vulnerabilities, and scan all devices re

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Malicious-software controls prohibit unauthorised downloads and doubtful sites, keep reputable anti-virus current, block executables and mobile code with known vulnerabilities, and scan all devices regularly with recovery procedures

controls.title: Critical information processing facilities sit in secure areas with security barriers and entry controls; access is restricted to authorised personnel and reviewed regularly; buildings give minimum in

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Critical information processing facilities sit in secure areas with security barriers and entry controls; access is restricted to authorised personnel and reviewed regularly; buildings give minimum indication of purpose

controls.title: Data centre sites consider environmental threats; environmental monitoring (fire, smoke, temperature, water, dust) and protection from power failure (UPS, backup generator) are in place

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Data centre sites consider environmental threats; environmental monitoring (fire, smoke, temperature, water, dust) and protection from power failure (UPS, backup generator) are in place

controls.title: Third-party access to secure areas is approved and monitored; recruitment of permanent and temporary technology staff and contractors includes verification and background checks

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Third-party access to secure areas is approved and monitored; recruitment of permanent and temporary technology staff and contractors includes verification and background checks

controls.title: A project management framework specifies the methodology for major technology projects: responsibilities, activity breakdown, time and resource budgets, milestones, checkpoints, dependencies, quality

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A project management framework specifies the methodology for major technology projects: responsibilities, activity breakdown, time and resource budgets, milestones, checkpoints, dependencies, quality assurance, risk assessment and approvals

controls.title: A full project life-cycle methodology governs development, implementation and maintenance of major systems from initiation through feasibility, requirements, design, development, testing, training, im

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A full project life-cycle methodology governs development, implementation and maintenance of major systems from initiation through feasibility, requirements, design, development, testing, training, implementation, operation and maintenance

controls.title: The life-cycle methodology defines roles and deliverables per phase and ensures security requirements are identified with business requirements, built, tested and implemented

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The life-cycle methodology defines roles and deliverables per phase and ensures security requirements are identified with business requirements, built, tested and implemented

controls.title: An independent party (QA, TRM or technology audit) conducts a quality assurance review of major projects for compliance with the methodology, policies, control requirements, regulations and law

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An independent party (QA, TRM or technology audit) conducts a quality assurance review of major projects for compliance with the methodology, policies, control requirements, regulations and law

controls.title: A formal acceptance process promotes only tested and approved systems to production; testing is in a separate environment; production data is not used in testing unless de-sensitised and approved by t

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A formal acceptance process promotes only tested and approved systems to production; testing is in a separate environment; production data is not used in testing unless de-sensitised and approved by the information owner; performance testing precedes promotion

controls.title: A formal software package acquisition process evaluates the package (licence, functionality, performance, security) and the supplier (financial condition, reputation, technical capability)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A formal software package acquisition process evaluates the package (licence, functionality, performance, security) and the supplier (financial condition, reputation, technical capability)

controls.title: Ongoing maintenance and support of software packages are specified in formal contracts; escrow is considered for mission-critical packages

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Ongoing maintenance and support of software packages are specified in formal contracts; escrow is considered for mission-critical packages

controls.title: A formal change management process covers classification and impact, roles with segregation of duties so no one person can change production unreviewed, version control and audit trails, scheduling an

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A formal change management process covers classification and impact, roles with segregation of duties so no one person can change production unreviewed, version control and audit trails, scheduling and tracking, rollback, and post-implementation verification

controls.title: Emergency changes follow formal procedures and are approved by the information owner and relevant parties at the time, or endorsed by the information owner as soon as practicable afterwards

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Emergency changes follow formal procedures and are approved by the information owner and relevant parties at the time, or endorsed by the information owner as soon as practicable afterwards

controls.title: Emergency changes are logged and backed up (previous and changed versions and data), reviewed by independent personnel, and replaced by proper fixes through normal change management

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Emergency changes are logged and backed up (previous and changed versions and data), reviewed by independent personnel, and replaced by proper fixes through normal change management

controls.title: Service level agreements with business units cover availability, performance, capacity for growth and user support, with procedures to manage delivery

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Service level agreements with business units cover availability, performance, capacity for growth and user support, with procedures to manage delivery

controls.title: An IT operations manual documents operator tasks, job scheduling and execution, and on-site and off-site backup of data and software (frequency, scope, retention) for production and development

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An IT operations manual documents operator tasks, job scheduling and execution, and on-site and off-site backup of data and software (frequency, scope, retention) for production and development

controls.title: A problem management system responds to IT operational incidents, escalates to IT management, and records, analyses and tracks incidents to rectification; a helpdesk provides front-line support

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A problem management system responds to IT operational incidents, escalates to IT management, and records, analyses and tracks incidents to rectification; a helpdesk provides front-line support

controls.title: Application performance is continuously monitored with timely exception reporting and forecasting to identify problems early and feed capacity planning

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Application performance is continuously monitored with timely exception reporting and forecasting to identify problems early and feed capacity planning

controls.title: Capacity planning covers backup systems and related facilities as well as production

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Capacity planning covers backup systems and related facilities as well as production

controls.title: IT facilities and equipment are maintained per industry practice and supplier intervals, with fault and maintenance records and a hardware and facility inventory of purchased and leased assets

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IT facilities and equipment are maintained per industry practice and supplier intervals, with fault and maintenance records and a hardware and facility inventory of purchased and leased assets

controls.title: An IT disaster recovery plan ensures critical application systems and technology services resume per business recovery requirements (TM-G-2), with adequate insurance of IT resources

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An IT disaster recovery plan ensures critical application systems and technology services resume per business recovery requirements (TM-G-2), with adequate insurance of IT resources

controls.title: Network management responsibility is assigned to skilled, resourced individuals; network standards, design, diagrams and procedures are documented, current, communicated and reviewed periodically

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Network management responsibility is assigned to skilled, resourced individuals; network standards, design, diagrams and procedures are documented, current, communicated and reviewed periodically

controls.title: Critical communications facilities are identified and single points of failure minimised by automatic re-routing, multiple exchanges and alternate telecommunications providers

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Critical communications facilities are identified and single points of failure minimised by automatic re-routing, multiple exchanges and alternate telecommunications providers

controls.title: The network is monitored continuously: services and performance against targets, traffic volumes and bottlenecks, and detection of unusual activity based on attack characteristics

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The network is monitored continuously: services and performance against targets, traffic volumes and bottlenecks, and detection of unusual activity based on attack characteristics

controls.title: Powerful network analysis and monitoring tools are protected from unauthorised use and restricted to authorised staff under approval and review

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Powerful network analysis and monitoring tools are protected from unauthorised use and restricted to authorised staff under approval and review

controls.title: Procedures for use of networks and network services define available services, authorisation of who may access them, and protection of access points, connections and services

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Procedures for use of networks and network services define available services, authorisation of who may access them, and protection of access points, connections and services

controls.title: Internal networks are segregated by access-control need; production systems sit in dedicated segments separated from internet, extranet and market-data traffic; sensitive inter-segment traffic is cont

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Internal networks are segregated by access-control need; production systems sit in dedicated segments separated from internet, extranet and market-data traffic; sensitive inter-segment traffic is controlled and tamper-protected

controls.title: Security parameter settings of routers, firewalls and network servers are reviewed regularly; audit trails of critical network devices are maintained and reviewed; operations staff are alerted in real

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security parameter settings of routers, firewalls and network servers are reviewed regularly; audit trails of critical network devices are maintained and reviewed; operations staff are alerted in real time to potential breaches

controls.title: Network certification assesses LAN/WAN additions or changes (dial ports, switches, terminal servers, gateways, routers, extranets, internet) for vulnerabilities and documents approval or required cont

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Network certification assesses LAN/WAN additions or changes (dial ports, switches, terminal servers, gateways, routers, extranets, internet) for vulnerabilities and documents approval or required controls

controls.title: WLAN policies cover approval, installation, operation and administration; a risk assessment of accessible information precedes implementation; a standard WLAN security configuration and network certif

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: WLAN policies cover approval, installation, operation and administration; a risk assessment of accessible information precedes implementation; a standard WLAN security configuration and network certification apply

controls.title: Stronger encryption and mutual authentication protect wireless-to-wired traffic where needed; WLANs are segregated from the corporate network (e.g. firewalls)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Stronger encryption and mutual authentication protect wireless-to-wired traffic where needed; WLANs are segregated from the corporate network (e.g. firewalls)

controls.title: Technology outsourcing follows SA-2 plus: providers have resources and expertise to meet IT control policies; critical services get an independent assessment of the provider's IT control environment w

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Technology outsourcing follows SA-2 plus: providers have resources and expertise to meet IT control policies; critical services get an independent assessment of the provider's IT control environment with the report provided to the HKMA; agreements specify performance standards, obligations, ownership and sub-contracting notification or approval; an annual assessment confirms the control environment of critical providers; excessive reliance on a single provider is avoided; a contingency and exit plan exists for critical outsourced services

controls.title: Guidelines govern other major technology service providers (telecommunications, network operators): selection, approval of material exceptions and avoidance of over-reliance on a single provider for c

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Guidelines govern other major technology service providers (telecommunications, network operators): selection, approval of material exceptions and avoidance of over-reliance on a single provider for critical services

controls.title: A technology and cyber risk management framework proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of operations is in place, consistent with IC-1 and TM-G-1

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: A technology and cyber risk management framework proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of operations is in place, consistent with IC-1 and TM-G-1

controls.title: Significant cyber incidents are reported promptly to the HKMA and, where appropriate, other relevant authorities (e.g. PCPD, CSTCB) under prevailing legal and regulatory obligations

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Significant cyber incidents are reported promptly to the HKMA and, where appropriate, other relevant authorities (e.g. PCPD, CSTCB) under prevailing legal and regulatory obligations

controls.title: Regular Cyber Resilience Assessment Framework (C-RAF) assessments are conducted — inherent risk assessment, maturity assessment, and iCAST for medium or high inherent risk — raising cyber defence matu

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Regular Cyber Resilience Assessment Framework (C-RAF) assessments are conducted — inherent risk assessment, maturity assessment, and iCAST for medium or high inherent risk — raising cyber defence maturity to the assessed exposure

controls.title: Secure Tertiary Data Backup (STDB) is adopted so critical data can be recovered if a cyber attack compromises both production and backup environments

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Secure Tertiary Data Backup (STDB) is adopted so critical data can be recovered if a cyber attack compromises both production and backup environments

controls.title: The AI exchanges cyber threat intelligence through the Cyber Intelligence Sharing Platform (CISP) under the Cybersecurity Fortification Initiative

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The AI exchanges cyber threat intelligence through the Cyber Intelligence Sharing Platform (CISP) under the Cybersecurity Fortification Initiative
